title: Roman and neighboring polity boundaries
time_resolution: dated intervals rendered on an annual timeline
notes: Each geometry persists from FromYear through ToYear. Annual playback is display interpolation, not an annual observation. Geometry is simplified for web display.

title: Roman military capacity estimates
notes: Army size and equipment loads are central estimates. Low and high fields document the model range but are intentionally not drawn as uncertainty bands.

title: Military capacity of Roman rivals
time_resolution: 50-year modeled points plus dated campaign anchors
notes: Lines connect modeled capacity estimates. Outlined points are campaign-specific force estimates and are not estimates of total state manpower.

title: Physical and geographic basemap
notes: Modern coastlines, rivers, and borders provide orientation only and are not evidence for ancient political boundaries.
